# A32-S07: Correspondence

Edited source text. [████] marks omissions.

Oh how typical, just exactly where we can't move ourselves. But they 
 have to get [████] together with Leder Lars, if they are to be able to move 
 on something. And if we want a chance in the circus!

Fingers crossed that they can move. Otherwise you can perhaps offer them that 
 you and I go out to them? DSP is very mobile.
